Applies request-scoped external findings before output rendering

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":[116,111,107,101,110,45,55,52,50,57,32,101,109,97,105,108,101,100,32,97,108,105,99,101,64,101,120,97,109,112,108,101,46,99,111,109,46],\"filename\":\"external-findings.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config_Config = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extractWithExternalRedaction(input, config_Config, "[{\"Type\":\"inspection_token\",\"Text\":\"token-7429\",\"Score\":0.99,\"Attributes\":{\"provider\":\"aws\"}}]", "unicode_code_points", 8)
    println(result.results.first().content)
}
```
